# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)</sub>
- **Role:** Doctor / Physician  <sub>[v4 c31 P12](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0012), [v4 c31 P13](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0013)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Hughie  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Hugh is a tall, broad-shouldered young man with good looks and wavy chestnut hair. He has mischievous light-brown or bright, direct eyes, a open face, and a mouth prone to a mocking grin or smile.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

Hugh is lively, mischievous, and possesses a strong sense of humor, often engaging in playful teasing or class pranks. He is popular, brave, and honest enough to admit his own fault when provoking others. Guided by high principles, he guards his speech, mind, and actions to remain worthy of those he cares about. He is also dedicated, hardworking, and compassionate in his medical practice.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v3 c27 P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035), [v4 c31 P12](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0012), [v4 c31 P13](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0013)_

## Traits

- Mischievous and playful  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033)</sub>
- Honest and accountable  <sub>[v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042)</sub>
- Appreciative of humor  <sub>[v3 c27 P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035)</sub>
- High-principled and self-vigilant  <sub>[v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)</sub>

## Abilities

- Medical and surgical practice  <sub>[v4 c31 P12](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0012), [v4 c31 P13](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0013)</sub>
- Academic excellence and competition  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Goals

- To live a life worthy of Nell Harcourt's companionship and affection  <sub>[v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)</sub>

## History

After living in Alberta for three years with his father, Hugh returned to Brierley and entered the local school, where he quickly demonstrated academic strength. On his first afternoon back in class, he teased Nell Harcourt by pulling her crimson plait and calling her 'Carrots', prompting Nell to break her slate over his head; Hugh bravely spoke up to take the blame from the schoolmaster. Over time, he grew into a handsome, principled youth who maintained a deep admiration for Nell. He later pursued a medical career, taking over Doctor Dave's practice and treating patients around Seven Gulls Harbor, including spending a full night at Allonby's saving a woman's life. He eventually married Nell, settling down with her in a small home at Seven Gulls where they regularly received visitors such as Captain Saul.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v4 c9 P0](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0000), [v4 c9 P1](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0001), [v4 c31 P12](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0012), [v4 c31 P15](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0015)_

## Background by volume

- Son of John Carrow
- Spent three years living in Alberta with his father due to his father's illness  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- Attended Brierley school after returning from Alberta  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031)</sub>
- Learned a new medical method at Portmaris Hospital
